Fang holds a Master's degree in Asian Studies and International Security from the Elliott School of International Affairs at George Washington University and a Bachelor's degree in Political Science from National Chengchi University.

zh.name: 王勻采
zh.bio: 國立政治大學廣播電視學系畢業，為客家委員會客語薪傳師（文學類）、客委會第一屆青年諮詢委員，現於客委會「臺灣客語語料庫」計畫擔任專任助理。現居新北市，出生並成長於新竹，父為桃園平鎮人（四縣、海陸）、母為屏東竹田人（南四縣），王氏祖堂為饒平底，與客家有著多層且深厚的血緣連結。現已通過客語四縣中高級、大埔中高級、海陸中級、饒平初級、詔安初級。曾獲後生文學獎、教育部臺灣臺語及臺灣客語文學獎。

en.name: Anne Wang
en.bio: Graduating from the Department of Radio and Television at National Chengchi University, the individual is a Hakka language instructor (literature category) certified by the Hakka Affairs Council. They also served as a member of the first Youth Advisory Committee of the Hakka Affairs Council and are currently working as a full-time assistant on the "Taiwan Hakka Language Corpus" project. Residing in New Taipei City, they were born and raised in Hsinchu, with their father hailing from Pingzhen, Taoyuan, and their mother from Chutian, Pingtung. With deep and multi-layered Hakka heritage, their family roots trace back to Raoping. They have passed the intermediate and advanced proficiency exams in the Four-County Hakka dialect, advanced proficiency in the Dapu dialect, intermediate proficiency in the Haifeng-Lufeng dialect, and beginner proficiency in the Raoping and Zhaoan dialects. They have been honored with the Young Writers' Award and the Ministry of Education's Taiwan Holo and Taiwan Hakka Literary Award.

zh.name: 王向榮
zh.bio:
長期 g0v 零時政府參與者，在 g0v 曾發起新聞小幫手、求職小幫手、台灣公司資料、開放政治獻金、開放標案等專案，並且曾因為求職小幫手被媒體稱為佛心工程師，2023年成立歐噴公司，嘗試以公司模式推動開放資料，希望可以透過開源和開放的力量讓世界更好。

身為 g0v 國會松的發起人，他會帶來自己整理好的立法院資料，邀請參與者一同協作，挖掘資料中的寶藏。他樂於分享立法知識、資料與開發工具，希望吸引更多同好，一起讓立法院資料更透明、也更好用。

他同時也是歐噴（OpenFun）的創辦人，及 LawTrace 專案的坑主。他相信開放資料的價值不該只停留在「公開」，而是要讓更多人真正用得上。關心立法院的運作與立法流程，他持續開發各種立院開放資料的小工具並開源釋出，期待讓更多人能輕鬆理解國會正在發生的事。

en.name: Ronny Wang
en.bio:
As a long-time participant in g0v, I've launched several civic engagement projects like News Helper, Job Helper, Taiwan Company Data, Open Political Donations, and Open Procurement Projects. My efforts with Job Helper even earned me the nickname "Kindhearted Engineer" from the media. In 2023, I founded OpenFun, aiming to promote open data through a company model, harnessing the power of open-source and transparency to make the world a better place.

As the initiator of g0v's Congress Hackathons, I bring meticulously organized data from the Legislative Yuan and invite participants to collaborate and uncover valuable insights. I am eager to share my knowledge of legislation, data, and development tools in hopes of attracting more enthusiasts to help make legislative data more transparent and user-friendly.

Additionally, as the founder of OpenFun and the lead of the LawTrace project, I believe that the value of open data should go beyond mere disclosure; it should be accessible and useful to everyone. With a keen interest in the operations and legislative processes of the Legislative Yuan, I continue to develop small tools for legislative open data and release them as open-source, aiming to help more people easily understand what's happening in Congress.

zh.name: 王晉謙
zh.bio:
- 722 高雄行人路權大遊行發起人 & 總召
- 下一代人本交通促進會第一、二屆理事長
- 臺北市青年事務諮詢委員會委員

en.name: Nolan Wang
en.bio:
- Initiator and Chief Organizer of the Kaohsiung Pedestrian Rights March
- First and Second Term President of the Next Generation Human-Centered Transportation Association
- Member of the Taipei City Youth Affairs Advisory Committee

zh.name: 王皓梅
zh.bio: 國立臺灣科技大學設計研究所畢業，現於 justfont 負責設計、字型專案、內容行銷與教育推廣等。曾主導開發 jf 7000 當務字集開源計畫，並參與嘉市體、洛神行書、柑仔蜜、精靈文字體等字型專案。也透過講座、工作坊與社群媒體，推廣字型與文字排印知識。

en.name: Howmay Wang
en.bio: Graduating from the Institute of Design at National Taiwan University of Science and Technology, the individual is currently responsible for design, font projects, content marketing, and educational outreach at justfont. They led the development of the open-source JF 7000 Essential font project and participated in various font projects such as Jia City Font, Luoshen Script, Kanami, and Sprite Typeface. Additionally, they promote knowledge of fonts and typography through lectures, workshops, and social media.

zh.name: 左邊女孩
zh.bio: 一個只用左手寫字、左腳走路的左邊女孩，中度腦性麻痺患者，幻想成為身障作家、倡議家、文字及社會學中毒者。將所有的歧視、不公平與霸凌都刻成身體的印記，用左手緩慢但堅持書寫的女性身障議題，展現最特別且真實的「經驗藝術」。

en.name: Leftgirl
en.bio: A girl who writes with her left hand and walks with her left foot, living with moderate cerebral palsy, dreams of becoming a writer and advocate for people with disabilities, deeply passionate about literature and sociology. She transforms all discrimination, injustice, and bullying into marks on her body, and uses her left hand to slowly but persistently write about issues affecting women with disabilities, creating a unique and authentic form of "experiential art."

zh.name: 白取耕一郎
zh.bio: 日本公民科技組織 proj-inclusive 創辦人暨負責人。一般社團法人防窮研究所創辦人暨理事長。拓殖大學副教授。行政學博士。提出並持續研究「防窮」概念（即預防貧困的方法論）。

en.name: Koichiro Shiratori
en.bio: Founder and leader of proj-inclusive, a Japanese civic tech organization. Founder and Chairperson of the Institute for Poverty Prevention. Associate Professor at Takushoku University. Holds a Ph.D. in Public Administration. Proposes and continuously researches the concept of 防窮, an approach for poverty prevention.

zh.name: 何雨忻
zh.bio: 經濟學徒，台灣史上第一人因戶政資料外洩控告戶政事務所勝訴，成功更換身分證字號

en.name: Bobby Ho
en.bio: A PhD student in Economics, the first person in Taiwan's to successfully sue a household registration office over a personal data leak, winning the right to change their national ID number.

zh.name: 亦白
zh.bio: 灣區g0v後台，待過媒體、劇場與偏鄉教育，熱愛黑白歌舞電影而開始跳swing dance.

en.name: Toby Liang
en.bio: A g0v Bay Area backstage member who has worked in media, theater, and rural education, and is a swing dance enthusiast with a passion for classic black-and-white musical films.

zh.name: 吳嶽森
zh.bio: 吳嶽森為數產署簡任視察。數位發展部透過「算力、資料、人才、行銷、資金」等五大政策資源，為產業界打造更健全的發展環境。針對「人才」議題，數產署與民間單位共同合作，透過發佈《AI 產業人才認定指引》，將人才結構化為AI 研究、開發、應用三大類，並明定 5 大能力類型與對應證照，建立求職者和需才企業對於AI人才的共通基本標準，目前已有超過20家認證、培訓機構認同並參與共同推動。此外，數產署也持續透過包括innoserve、高中扎根和GenAI Stars等不同的培育和競賽活動，並善用與AWS、Microsoft等國際大廠合辦黑客松和技術日等方式，協助落實國內人才AI賦能。

en.name: Yueh-Sen Wu
en.bio:
Yueh-Sen Wu, Senior Executive officer of the Administration for Digital Industries (ADI). The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MODA) is building a better environment for the AI industry by focusing on five key areas: computing power, data, talent, marketing, and funding.

Regarding the talent issue, the ADI teamed up with the private sector to release the "AI Industrial Talent Recognition Guidelines." These guidelines break down AI roles into three categories—Research, Development, and Application—and list five core skills and relevant certifications. This creates a clear, common standard for both job seekers and hiring companies. So far, over 20 training and certification organizations have joined the effort.

On top of that, the ADI is helping people level up their AI skills through competitions and programs like InnoServe, GenAI Stars, and high school AI cultivation programs. ADI also cooperates with AWS and Microsoft to host hackathons and tech days, making sure local talent stays ahead of the curve.

zh.name: 李又如
zh.bio: 李又如，資料記者，沒有特定新聞路線的雜食系，2017 年進到一個工程師超過半數的團隊以後開始慢慢長理科腦。喜歡資料新聞不設限的特性，覺得每天都在學習新事物。作品曾入圍國內外各大新聞獎，曾獲亞洲卓越新聞獎（SOPA Awards）、全球華文永續報導獎。

en.name: You Ru Li
en.bio: A data journalist, embraces a diverse approach to news without sticking to a specific beat. After joining a team in 2017 where engineers made up the majority, Li gradually developed a more scientific mindset. Li appreciates the limitless nature of data journalism, finding joy in the opportunity to learn something new every day. Their work has been nominated for various prestigious journalism awards both domestically and internationally, and they have been honored with the Society of Publishers in Asia (SOPA) Awards and the Global Chinese Sustainability Journalism Awards.

zh.name: 李比鄰
zh.bio: Billion 在 2016 年共同發起 Cofacts 真的假的專案。她長期在婚姻平權、開放與自由的領域深耕多元的倡議與對話，比鄰也開發對抗不實訊息的培力課程。她專精公民科技與數位民主活動，曾獲選美國國務院專業人才交流計畫之學友與去中心化學友專案，在美國 PolitiFact 與 Poynter進行訪問學者交流，與不同國家的貢獻者進行協作與澄清資訊，也組織了ＯＳＩＮＴ公開來源情報的查核社群推廣查核技巧與媒體識讀訓練。曾前往泰國、新加坡、澳洲、美國、加拿大、英國、突尼西亞、阿爾巴尼亞、歐盟、哥斯大黎加與聯合國日內瓦參與會議或發表演說。Billion 希望可以連結社會，並透過社群連結與教育推廣抵禦不實資訊的威脅。

en.name: Billion Lee
en.bio: Billion is the cofounder of Cofacts, a project she initiated in 2016. She is a staunch advocate for marriage equality and open freedom, dedicating herself to bridging diverse communities and providing empowerment courses to combat disinformation. She is expertise in civic technology and digital democracy. Billion has participated in the Fellowship of Professional Fellows Program and the decentralized Dweb Camp fellowship. She has visited PolitiFact and Poynter in the United States for exchanges, fostering collaboration with contributors from various countries to clarify information. Besides, she manages a community focused on developing OSINT fact-checking skills and enhancing media literacy. Billion is experienced in public speaking. She has delivered talks in Thailand, Singapore, Australia, the UＳ, UK , Canada, Tunisia, Albania, the European Union, Costa Rica, and the United Nations in Geneva. Billion's efforts are aimed at creating a more informed and connected society, combating disinformation through education and community engagement.

zh.name: 李可心
zh.bio:
現為美國台灣觀測站共同編輯，並於美商政策顧問公司擔任分析師。同時為公視《新聞超小號》節目主播，經常出現於敏迪選讀、斐姨所思等節目。

李可心過去為台灣資訊環境研究中心（IORG）研究員，也曾擔任《Taiwan Talks》節目共同主持人。畢業於紐約大學國際關係碩士，專長印太地區地緣與商業政治分析。

en.name: Jasmine Lee
en.bio:
Currently serving as a co-editor for the American Taiwan Observatory and working as an analyst at an American policy consulting firm, Li Kexin is also a news anchor for the Public Television Service program "News Trumpet." She frequently appears on programs like "Mindy's Reading Selection" and "Fei Yi's Thoughts."

Previously, Li was a researcher at the Taiwan Information Environment Research Center (IORG) and co-hosted the program "Taiwan Talks." She holds a master's degree in international relations from New York University, specializing in geopolitical and commercial political analysis in the Indo-Pacific region.

zh.name: 李冠霖
zh.bio: 國立臺灣大學客家研究社第 33 任社長（2024–2026），行政院客家委員會青年諮詢委員（2025–2026），客家電視臺行銷部活動組實習生（2025）。客語自主學習經驗五年，從零開始學到這下通過四縣腔中級、海陸腔初級、大埔腔初級。同時乜有通過教育部臺語認證高級（C1）、成大臺語認證高級（C1）、族語能力認證秀姑巒阿美語中級。擔任社長期間創建 Instagram 同 Threads 社群，平常都使用全客文發文，到今下 IG 有 600+ 追蹤、Threads 乜有 1100+ 追蹤，同時乜摎社員人數對 5 儕左右，經營到這下有 20+ 儕。

en.name: Li Gon Lim
en.bio:
As the 33rd President of the Hakka Studies Club at National Taiwan University (2024–2026), and a Youth Advisory Committee Member for the Hakka Affairs Council of the Executive Yuan (2025–2026), I have actively engaged in promoting Hakka culture. I also interned in the Events Group of the Marketing Department at Hakka TV in 2025. With five years of self-directed Hakka language learning, I progressed from beginner to intermediate in the Si-xian dialect and reached beginner level in the Hailu and Dapu dialects. Additionally, I achieved advanced (C1) certification in Taiwanese from both the Ministry of Education and National Cheng Kung University, and intermediate proficiency in the Siou-ku-luan Amis language through the Indigenous Language Proficiency Certification.

During my presidency, I launched an Instagram and Threads community, consistently using the Hakka language for all posts. This effort has grown our Instagram following to over 600 and Threads following to over 1,100. Additionally, membership in the club expanded from around 5 members to over 20, reflecting our vibrant and engaged community.

zh.name: 豆泥
zh.bio: 黃豆泥，由於沈迷網際網路與社會網絡的深層結構，自醫師工作離職，現致力於將密碼龐克精神融入台灣數位社會。現為以太坊諮詢小組「森友會」（Silviculture Society） 成員，並為 2025 年哈佛甘迺迪學院（HKS）民主興革訪問學者。筆者曾任職於數位發展部推動分散式技術，現服務於抗審查內容平台 Matters。豆泥現同時參與 web3 公民科技社群 FAB DAO，透過區塊鏈技術幫助台灣非營利行動，該組織曾於林茲電子藝術節展出。

en.name: Mashbean
en.bio: Deeply engaged in the intricate structures of the internet and social networks, left a medical career to focus on integrating the principles of cypherpunk into Taiwan's digital society. Currently, Soybean is a member of the Ethereum advisory group "Silviculture Society" and is set to be a visiting scholar at Harvard Kennedy School's Democracy Innovation program in 2025. Previously, Soybean worked at the Ministry of Digital Development promoting decentralized technologies and now contributes to the anti-censorship content platform Matters. Soybean is also involved with the civic tech community FAB DAO, which leverages blockchain technology to support nonprofit initiatives in Taiwan. This organization has been showcased at the Ars Electronica Festival in Linz.

zh.name: 周詳
zh.bio: 開放文化基金會 Tech Lead、零曜科技執行長，前數位發展部成員，深耕政府機關的 DevOps、Kubernetes、Cloud Native 與 Zero Trust 技術導入。曾多次受邀於 Kubernetes Summit、DevOpsDays、Modern Web Conference、MOPCON 等知名論壇分享，兼具政策視野與技術實力。

en.name: Sean Chou
en.bio: As the Tech Lead at the Open Culture Foundation and CEO of Zeroflare this individual has a rich background in civic engagement, particularly in integrating DevOps, Kubernetes, Cloud Native, and Zeroflare within government agencies. Formerly a member of the Department of Digital Affairs they have been invited multiple times to speak at renowned forums such as Kubernetes Summit, DevOpsDays, Modern Web Conference, and MOPCON. They bring a unique blend of policy insight and technical expertise to their work.

zh.name: 林怡廷
zh.bio: 長期關注自主學習與數位素養，曾任實驗教育老師並創辦島島阿學。擔任 g0v 零時小學校專案經理期間，與各國公民科技社群推動數位公民素養並將資源帶入校園，並共同編寫《公民科技專案與社群手冊》中英日三版。現任台灣人工智慧學校策略夥伴總監，負責公民 AI 素養計畫，致力於串聯產官學共創包容且民主的 AI 生態系。

en.name: Tiff Lin
en.bio: With a long-standing focus on self-directed learning and digital citizenship literacy, I formerly served as an experimental education teacher and founded Dao Dao Learning Community. During their tenure as Project Manager for g0v Sch001, we collaborated with international civic tech communities to promote digital citizenship and integrate resources into schools. We also co-authored the Civic Tech Project and Community Handbook, published in Chinese, English, and Japanese. Currently, I serve as the Director of Strategic Partnerships at the Taiwan AI Academy, leading the AI for ALL program initiative to bridge industry, government, and academia in building an inclusive and democratic AI ecosystem.

zh.name: 林雨蒼
zh.bio: 台南人，g0v貢獻者。

en.name: Billy Lin
en.bio: Tainan resident and g0v contributor.

zh.name: 林柏勛
zh.bio:
行人零死亡推動聯盟理事
前時代力量決策委員、時代力量交通零死亡願景召集人

en.name: Teddy Lin
en.bio: Pedestrian Zero Fatality Initiative Board Member, Former New Power Party Decision-Making Committee Member, and Vision Zero Traffic Advocate for the New Power Party

zh.name: 林韋丞
zh.bio: 人類學家，非技術背景。長期關注數位人權、網路治理、開放原始碼、公民科技、開放資料與開放政府。目前從資安院角度關注資訊環境、公私協力與數位韌性。

en.name: weichen
en.bio: Anthropologist with a non-technical background, dedicated to civic engagement. I have a long-standing interest in digital rights, internet governance, open source, civic technology, open data, and open government. Currently, I focus on the information environment, public-private collaboration, and digital resilience from the perspective of cybersecurity.

zh.name: 林糖糖
zh.bio: 設計背景出身，也是一部分的花蓮人，從光復馬太鞍溪流域後開始思考系統在極端情境下如何影響人的行動與協作。透過少量實際進入災害現場協助者的訪談，整理救災過程中常被忽略的斷裂經驗。關注災害情境中資訊交接、角色流動與經驗傳承等問題，嘗試從設計與系統思考的角度，提出對科技介入救災的不同提問。

en.name: Tang Tang Lin
en.bio: With a background in design and roots in Hualien, I've been contemplating how systems influence human actions and collaboration in extreme situations since the restoration of the Mataian Creek watershed. By conducting interviews with a few individuals who have directly assisted in disaster-stricken areas, I've gathered insights on the often-overlooked disruptions experienced during disaster relief efforts. My focus is on issues such as information transfer, role fluidity, and the transmission of experiences in disaster scenarios. I aim to explore different questions about how technology can intervene in disaster relief from the perspectives of design and systems thinking.

zh.name: 欣慈
zh.bio: 國際政策研究公司顧問、曾任Youth Democracy Network諮委，耕耘公民外交與國際民主培力。有感於自己對於基層或地方政治的參與不足，所以加入罷免運動學習，2025在台北的罷免區域努力用工作之餘支援現場的聲援力量。

en.name: Cynthia
en.bio: As a consultant for an international policy research firm and a former advisory member of the Youth Democracy Network, I have been dedicated to civic diplomacy and the empowerment of international democracy. Recognizing my lack of involvement in grassroots or local politics, I decided to join a recall movement to learn more. In 2025, I devoted my spare time to supporting and rallying on the ground in a recall district in Taipei.

zh.name: 芬達
zh.bio: 畢業於東華自然資源與環境學系，曾在原民部落、國家公園、營造廠等不同立場的公、私單位工作過，同時也是地球公民基金會的志工，長期關心花蓮的生態與社會議題，目前是位於花蓮的自由工作者，工作內容多為生態/社區解說、動植物調查、生態檢核等生態或社區工作。

en.name: Fanta
en.bio: Graduating from the Department of Natural Resources and Environmental Studies at Dong Hwa University, I have worked in various public and private sectors, including indigenous communities, national parks, and construction companies. I am also a volunteer with the Citizen of the Earth Foundation, where I have long been involved in ecological and social issues in Hualien. Currently, as a freelancer based in Hualien, my work primarily focuses on ecological and community engagement, such as ecological/community interpretation, flora and fauna surveys, and ecological assessments.

zh.name: 侯宜秀
zh.bio:
中年轉職的法律人，從 2000 年代初期就在法律、科技與公共政策的交叉口紮根。2012 年起深度參與 g0v 公民科技社群，曾任揪松團輪值主席、零時小學校發起人，也是台灣 AI 領域早期社群建設的推手——協助創立台灣人工智慧學校基金會並擔任秘書長。2020 至 2022 年間以民間委員身份推動完成台灣立法院首份「開放國會行動方案」。

她帶著社群視角走進體制，現任數位發展部政務次長，主責數位產業、國際數位合作、資料治理與創新應用，也兼任部發言人。近年持續關注 AI 治理的民主性、包容性與安全性，期望台灣能成為「最會用 AI 的國家」。

en.name: Isabel Hou
en.bio:
A legal professional who pivoted mid-career, she has been rooted at the intersection of law, technology, and public policy since the early 2000s. Since 2012, she has been deeply involved in the g0v civic tech community, serving as a rotating chair of the jothon task force and founder of Sch001. She was also a pioneer in Taiwan’s AI community building, co-founding the Taiwan AI Academy Foundation and serving as its Secretary-General. Between 2020 and 2022, she served as a civil society member of the committee that drove the completion of Taiwan’s first Open Parliament Action Plan.

Bringing a community-driven perspective into the establishment, she is currently the Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Digital Affairs. Her portfolio covers digital industry, international cooperation, data governance, and innovative applications, while also serving as the Ministry’s spokesperson. In recent years, she has focused on the democracy, inclusivity, and safety of AI governance, with the vision of making Taiwan the “savviest nation in utilizing AI.”

zh.name: 洪銘澤
zh.bio: Research and Action研究員，主要分析台灣氣候議題與能源政策相關的錯假資訊，目前的工作聚焦於氣候及能源論述的在地脈絡，嘗試從地方政府、企業與社區的角度理解這些議題如何被形塑、互相影響，以及不同的敘事如何生成發展。

en.name: Ming-Tse Hong
en.bio: Research and Action Researcher, primarily analyzes misinformation related to Taiwan's climate issues and energy policies. The current work focuses on the local context of climate and energy discourse, attempting to understand how these issues are shaped and influenced from the perspectives of local governments, businesses, and communities. The research also explores how different narratives are developed and evolve.

zh.name: 唐若凌
zh.bio: 東京大學先端科技研究中心、中國戰略風險研究所及太平洋論壇研究員，並為2026年亞太基金會年輕領袖。研究聚焦中國政治與認知作戰、印太經濟安全與基建韌性。

en.name: Athena Tong
en.bio: Athena Tong is currently a Nonresident Vasey Fellow at Pacific Forum. She also serves as a Visiting Researcher at the University of Tokyo and a Research Associate & Programme Lead at the China Strategic Risks Institute (CSRI), a London-based think tank specialising in geopolitical risk and economic security. She sits on the Advisory Board of NetMission.Asia and the Public Opinion Research Project for Domestic and Overseas Hongkongers. Her research interests include counter-influence operations, cognitive and psychological warfare, economic security, and China’s global influence strategies, with a particular focus on East Asia. She was a Visiting Scholar at the Research Institute for Democracy, Society, and Emerging Technology (DSET) in Taiwan.

zh.name: 徐光成
zh.bio:
徐光成，目前是「前線民主」成員，研究前線國家怎麼面對衝突風險，以及台灣從國防到社會韌性，可以如何找到合適的解方以因應區域衝突壓力，並曾於2025年辦理「公民社會戰爭推演」。

光成目前任職於政府部門，主要負責全社會防衛韌性議題的相關工作，此前曾任職於國防安全研究院與國家安全會議，在這三段工作中都關注於安全議題。此外，光成畢業於清華大學社會所碩士班中國研究組。

en.name: Tim Hsu
en.bio:
Tim Hsu is currently a member of ""Frontline Democracy,"" where he explores how frontline nations address conflict risks and how Taiwan can develop appropriate solutions to handle regional conflict pressures, ranging from national defense to social resilience. In 2025, he organized a ""Civil Society War Simulation.""

Guangcheng currently works in a government department, focusing on issues related to societal defense resilience. Previously, he worked at the National Defense and Security Research Institute and the National Security Council, where he consistently focused on security issues. He holds a master's degree in Chinese Studies from the sociology program at Tsinghua University.

zh.name: 徐洛文
zh.bio: 徐洛文是國立臺灣大學新聞研究所助理教授、多倫多大學蒙克國際研究中心公民實驗室研究員，前香港中文大學新聞及傳播學院助理教授（2014-2021）和谷歌亞太區言論自由事務負責人（2011-2014）。

en.name: Lokman Tsui
en.bio: Lokman Tsui is an Assistant Professor of the Graduate School of Journalism at the National University of Taiwan, Research Fellow with the Citizen Lab at the Munk School of Global Affairs and Public Policy of the University of Toronto, and formerly an Assistant Professor at the School of Journalism and Communication of the Chinese University of Hong Kong (2014-2021). Before CUHK, Tsui was Google's Head of Free Expression for Asia and the Pacific (2011-2014).

zh.name: 特邀講者
zh.bio: 講者為退役軍人與無人機工程師，具有多年歐洲與中東前沿戰事經驗，曾於美軍、烏克蘭等軍事單位，擔任小型無人飛行系統（sUAS）、反無人機系統（C-UAS）與電子作戰（EW）訓練教官。

en.name: Invited Speaker
en.bio: The speaker is a military veteran and drone engineer with extensive frontline combat experience across Europe and Middle East. He has served as an instructor for Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems (sUAS), Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems (C-UAS), and Electronic Warfare (EW) for military units, including the U.S. Army and Ukrainian forces.

zh.name: 荊輔翔
zh.bio:
無人機 / Meshtastic 工程師， CRC賽伯格韌性實驗室成員。

活躍於開源社群，曾任中研院資訊科學研究所研究助理，長期投入於韌體開發、物聯網通訊（LoRa/Mesh）、災害應變技術等領域。

en.name: Sean
en.bio:
Drone / Meshtastic Engineer, Member of the Cyborg Resilience Co-Lab (CRC)

Sean is an active open-source contributor and former Research Assistant at Academia Sinica, he specializes in firmware development, IoT communication (LoRa/Mesh), and disaster response tech. With expertise in Python, C, GCP, and DevOps, he has a strong foundation in open-source hardware and network protocols.

zh.name: 康秩群
zh.bio:
寶島客家廣播電臺/講客廣播電臺《Play Ball 運動開講》節目主持人、客家委員會諮詢委員。

不是客家人，卻誤打誤撞踏上客家奇幻旅程。還在慢慢探索、認識客家的同時，驚覺自己已攬上代表青年在客家界發聲的使命。在如此「旁觀者」與「當局者」交錯的身份中，提供不同視角的觀點，並擔任橋樑使更多人一同參與這趟旅程。

en.name: Piano Kang
en.bio: As a host of the "Play Ball" sports program on the Formosa Hakka Radio Station and an advisory member of the Hakka Affairs Council, I am deeply engaged in the civic exploration of Hakka culture. Although I am not of Hakka descent, I serendipitously embarked on a fascinating journey into the Hakka community. As I gradually explore and learn about Hakka traditions and values, I find myself taking on the important mission of representing youth voices within the Hakka sphere. Balancing the roles of both an observer and a participant, I strive to offer diverse perspectives and serve as a bridge to encourage more people to join this enriching journey of cultural discovery and civic involvement.

zh.name: 梁嘉麗
zh.bio: 梁嘉麗是香港離散媒體《追光者》創辦人之一、《光傳媒》前總編輯。

en.name: Shirley Leung
en.bio: Shirley Leung is a co-founder of a Hong Kong diasporic media outlet Pulse HK News, and formerly editor in chief of Photon Media.

zh.name: 莫莉
zh.bio: 媒體業（電視媒體，紙媒）工作多年，現於教育產業（大學）工作。太陽花啟蒙後關注國內外政治。工作緣故也長期關注中國。大罷免後，與罷團志工們共同成立在地民間防衛團體「板橋民主星際站」，持續推動在地民防自訓課程。同時，與雙北罷團的其他志工製作週更聲音節目《我們不是金魚腦》，對抗認知作戰、推廣時事探討。

en.name: Molly
en.bio: Having worked in the media industry (both television and print) for many years, I am now employed in the education sector at a university. After the Sunflower Movement, I became more attentive to domestic and international politics. Due to my job, I have also maintained a long-term focus on China. Following a major recall movement, I teamed up with fellow volunteers to establish a local civic defense group called the "Banqiao Democratic Star Station," which continues to promote local civil defense training courses. Additionally, I collaborate with other volunteers from the Taipei and New Taipei City recall movement to produce a weekly podcast, "We Are Not Goldfish Brains," aimed at countering misinformation and promoting discussions on current affairs.

zh.name: 郭家佑
zh.bio: artist, activist, and diplomat外交演員｜世界巡演中🇨🇭🇩🇪🇦🇹🇫🇷🇰🇷🇪🇸🇳🇱🇨🇿🇮🇹我有環遊世界的兩份工作➡️國家兩廳院「這不是個大使館」演員➡️數位外交協會創辦人

en.name: Chiayo Kuo
en.bio: Artist, activist, and diplomat: Engaged in civic activities around the world 🌍 | Currently on a global tour 🇨🇭🇩🇪🇦🇹🇫🇷🇰🇷🇪🇸🇳🇱🇨🇿🇮🇹 | Balancing two global roles ➡️ Actor in the production "This Is Not an Embassy" at the National Theater and Concert Hall ➡️ Founder of the Digital Diplomacy Association.

zh.name: 郭書成
zh.bio: 現任新北市汐止區湖興里的里長。看見村里是一個寂寞且缺乏掌聲的地方，於2019和朋友一起成立了「行動山棧花」，試圖打破同溫層，用「街聊」的方式促進政治議題的溝通。在2021年，和「實現會社」一起募集創立《獨立村里長學院》。認為政治不只是口水戰、不是政治明星的演出，而是有許多值得彎下腰來、好好耕耘的地方。

en.name: Guo Shu-Cheng
en.bio: The current village chief of Huxing Village in Xizhi District, New Taipei City, recognized that his community was a lonely place lacking in recognition. In 2019, he and some friends launched "Action Mountain Flower" to break out of echo chambers and foster communication on political issues through "street chats." By 2021, he collaborated with the "Realization Society" to establish the "Independent Village Chief Academy." He believes that politics is not just about debates or the performances of political celebrities; it's about the many areas that deserve dedicated attention and grassroots cultivation.

zh.name: 陳子非
zh.bio: 陳子非是資深新聞工作者，參與編採中國大陸和香港新聞超過十五年。

en.name: Zi-Fei Chen
en.bio: Zi-Fei CHEN is a senior journalist covering Mainland China and Hong Kong for more than 15 years.

zh.name: 陳伶志
zh.bio: 陳伶志博士目前是中央研究院資訊服務處處長，同時也是中央研究院資訊科學研究所研究員，並兼任台灣人工智慧學校執行長。畢業於美國加州大學洛杉磯分校（UCLA）計算機科學博士學位，專長於物聯網（IoT）、行動無線網路，以及結合 AI 技術的時空大數據分析。其代表性成果「微型 PM2.5 感測系統」已於全球 59 個國家部署超過 2 萬個感測器，推動空氣品質感測、即時資料分析與智慧城市應用。近年亦帶領團隊投入資安與行政數位轉型，並導入生成式 AI 於行政服務流程；同時在台灣人工智慧學校推動 AI 能力認證、公民 AI 素養與百工百業 AI 導入，致力提升全民 AI 素養與跨域應用。

en.name: Ling-Jyh Chen
en.bio: Dr. Ling-Jyh Chen is currently the Chief Executive Officer of Taiwan AI Academy and a Research Fellow at the Institute of Information Science, Academia Sinica. He also serves as the Director of the Department of Information Technology Services at Academia Sinica. Dr. Chen holds a PhD in Computer Science from UCLA, specializing in Internet of Things (IoT), Mobile Wireless Networks, and Spatio-temporal Big Data Analysis using AI technologies. His most notable achievement is the Micro PM2.5 Sensor System, which has successfully deployed over 20,000 sensors in 59 countries worldwide. This system promotes research and development in the field of micro air quality sensing, encompassing hardware and software, as well as real-time data analysis and smart city technologies.

zh.name: 陳家慶律師
zh.bio: 陳家慶，嘉義裔台中人，目前在台北擔任律師，執業領域包含資訊隱私法與數位人權，並在台北律師公會參與國際法委員會與憲法委員會，另外也曾與不同NGO與相關專業人士共同研擬法律草案以及相關倡議行動。

en.name: Chiaching Chen
en.bio: Originally from Chiayi and now residing in Taichung, is currently practicing as a lawyer in Taipei. His areas of practice include information privacy law and digital human rights. Actively engaged in civic activities, he participates in the International Law Committee and the Constitutional Committee of the Taipei Bar Association. He has also collaborated with various NGOs and professionals to draft legal proposals and advocate for related initiatives.

zh.name: 陳凱翔
zh.bio: One-Forty 創辦人，致力於建立一個實質多元友善的台灣社會。曾任職於社計事務所(Social Design)，專責於推動企業解決社會議題的共享價值策略。入選西雅圖 Perennial 社會創業家亞洲代表、Ashoka Changemaker 亞洲代表。

en.name: Kevin
en.bio: Founder of One-Forty, dedicated to building a truly diverse and inclusive society in Taiwan. He previously worked at Social Design, specializing in Shared Value strategies that empower corporations to solve social issues. He was selected as an Asian representative for Perennial (Seattle) and an Ashoka Changemaker.

zh.name: 陳意茹
zh.bio: 高雄美濃人，今下係臺師大臺文系、輔修歷史系个學生仔，乜係一儕中等教育學程个教程生。在臺師大客語學程个「客話打嘴鼓」帶等同學共下用客話講日常生活。共生音樂節第 13 屆設計組長、第 12、14 屆主持人。客家委員會青年諮詢委員。平常時係自由接案个平面設計師，乜有做過臺語／客話字稿、翻譯臺客語雙聲道个主持、展覽个客語語音導覽，斜槓不務正業，中意「置入性行銷」撖客話囥入去𠊎做个各種事頭裡背。

en.name: Ciinˇ I Iˇ
en.bio: A resident of Meinong, Kaohsiung, currently studying in the Department of Taiwanese Literature with a minor in History at National Taiwan Normal University, is also pursuing a Secondary Education Program. This individual actively engages fellow classmates in the "Hakka Chat" course, encouraging the use of the Hakka language in daily conversation. They have served as the design lead for the 13th edition of the Coexistence Music Festival and as a host for its 12th and 14th editions. Additionally, they are a Youth Advisory Committee member for the Hakka Affairs Council. In their free time, they work as a freelance graphic designer, have experience with Taiwanese/Hakka script writing, and have hosted bilingual Taiwanese-Hakka programs and provided Hakka audio guides for exhibitions. Passionate about integrating the Hakka language into various projects, they creatively incorporate it into all their endeavors.

zh.name: 陳瑞霖
zh.bio: OpenStreetMap and Wikidata 長期參與者

en.name: Raylin Chen
en.bio: A long time contributor of OpenStreetMap and Wikidata

zh.name: 彭　宬
zh.bio: g0v 數位韌性松共同創辦人，CRC賽伯格韌性實驗室成員。自 2023 年起探索數位韌性與台灣民防情境的交匯點。「數位韌性松」自 2023 年底開始聚會，盤點政府數位機構與民間團體的各種措施，思考如何讓台灣的網路基礎設施與關鍵服務更具韌性。

en.name: Cheng PENG
en.bio: Co-founder of the g0v Digital Resilience Hackathon and member of the Cyborg Resilience Co-Lab (CRC). Since 2023, he has been exploring the intersection of digital resilience and civil defense scenarios in Taiwan. The "Digital Resilience Hackathon" has been gathering since late 2023 to map out various measures taken by government digital agencies and civil society groups, brainstorming how to make Taiwan's network infrastructure and critical services more resilient.

zh.name: 逸晟
zh.bio: FAB DAO 貢獻者，長期在地方行動領域實踐，連結地方、議題與社群。

en.name: Yian
en.bio: FAB DAO contributors have been actively engaged in local civic actions for a long time, connecting communities, issues, and localities.

zh.name: 黃亮勳
zh.bio: Twinkle AI 創辦人，長期關注繁體中文語言模型與本土資料集建構。從社群出發發動內部自學，與一群來自不同領域的夥伴共同推進在地 AI 發展，曾於 Twinkle AI 一同釋出可於手機端運行的 3B 參數繁體中文推理模型 Formosa-1，並開源模型權重與評測框架 Twinkle Eval。亦發起 Formosa Vision 計畫，建立開放授權的台灣圖文資料集，補足在地文化語料的不足。

en.name: Liang-hsun Huang
en.bio: The founder of Twinkle AI has long been dedicated to the development of Traditional Chinese language models and local datasets. With a focus on community-driven initiatives, they have spearheaded internal self-learning efforts and collaborated with partners from various fields to advance local AI development. At Twinkle AI, they released Formosa-1, a 3B parameter Traditional Chinese inference model that can run on mobile devices, and made the model weights and evaluation framework, Twinkle Eval, open-source. They also initiated the Formosa Vision project to create an open-licensed Taiwanese image-text dataset, addressing the gap in local cultural language resources.

zh.name: 黃脩閔
zh.bio: 桃園平鎮客家人，屋下有三姊妹，自家係大姊，對臺灣大學法律學系、中央大學客家研究所、臺灣大學法律研究所（公法組）畢業。大學到研究所期間做過臺大客家社社長、中央廣播電臺「有料無料共下坐尞」客語廣播節目主持人、臺灣共生青年協會常務監事、臺灣法律人助理編輯。

en.name: Huang Hsiu Min
en.bio: In Taoyuan's Pingzhen district, there is a Hakka family with three sisters, and the eldest is deeply engaged in civic activities. She graduated from the Department of Law at National Taiwan University, the Graduate Institute of Hakka Studies at National Central University, and the Graduate Institute of Law (Public Law Division) at National Taiwan University. During her time in college and graduate school, she served as the president of the NTU Hakka Society, hosted the Hakka radio program "You Liao Wu Liao Gong Xia Zuo Liao" on Radio Taiwan International, was the executive supervisor of the Taiwan Coexistence Youth Association, and worked as an assistant editor for the Taiwan Legal Professionals.

zh.name: 黃靖庭
zh.bio: 地球公民基金會副執行長。花蓮台北兩地跑的環境倡議工作者，目前興趣是深入瞭解公務員的能與不能，在能源轉型路徑上，有時扮演反派，有時協助政策推進，對公部門來說可能亦正亦邪。現職為地球公民基金會的副執行長，駐紮台北辦公室的花蓮台北人。

en.name: Aries Huang
en.bio: Deputy Executive Director of the Global Citizens Foundation. An environmental advocate working between Hualien and Taipei, currently interested in deeply understanding the capabilities and limitations of civil servants. In the journey of energy transition, sometimes playing the role of an antagonist, while at other times assisting in policy advancement, which may be seen as both good and bad by public sectors. Currently serving as the Deputy Executive Director of the Global Citizens Foundation, based in the Taipei office, with roots in both Hualien and Taipei.

zh.name: 楊仁坤
zh.bio: 「港湖除銹」罷免團體副領銜人，是一位資深的電機與網路工程師，同時也是小企業負責人，職涯橫跨外商、國內經銷與外銷貿易，擁有商場實戰與組織管理經驗。2025 年大罷免運動期間，正值 65 歲屆齡退休之際，選擇投身公民行動，從建立團隊架構到執行各面向的實務工作，在第一線與志工團隊並肩成長。

en.name: Justin Yang
en.bio: The deputy leader of the "Ganghu Rust Removal" recall group is a seasoned electrical and network engineer, as well as a small business owner. With a career spanning multinational corporations, domestic distribution, and export trade, they possess hands-on business experience and organizational management skills. During the major recall movement in 2025, as they reached the retirement age of 65, they chose to dedicate themselves to civic engagement. They were involved in everything from building team structures to executing practical tasks, growing alongside the volunteer team on the front lines.

zh.name: 楊時鈞
zh.bio: 《天下雜誌》資深前端工程師，隸屬編輯部數位敘事組，專注於資料新聞與互動式數位敘事開發。主要負責資料處理、地圖與資料視覺化設計，以及大型新聞專題的技術實作，並致力於將資料分析與新聞報導結合，打造具敘事性的互動作品。近年參與多項地緣政治、選舉與能源議題的資料專題製作，並持續探索 AI 與資料流程在新聞工作中的應用。

en.name: Steven Yeo
en.bio: A senior front-end engineer at CommonWealth Magazine, part of the digital storytelling team within the editorial department, focuses on data journalism and the development of interactive digital narratives. Primarily responsible for data processing, map and data visualization design, and the technical implementation of large-scale news projects, this role is dedicated to integrating data analysis with news reporting to create narrative-driven interactive works. In recent years, the engineer has participated in data-driven projects on geopolitical issues, elections, and energy topics, while continually exploring the application of AI and data workflows in journalism to enhance civic engagement.

zh.name: 瑈瑈
zh.bio: 六堆客、桃園人。身為客人從來毋硬頸，中意創作音樂、語言、文學，有過文化展演、客語主持、音樂創作、語言教學、社區工作个經驗。創辦「客 客 客到人 Hakka Global」社群品牌，現下係客委會第一屆青年諮詢委員、第三屆行政院開放政府國家行動方案民間委員，過去乜有行政院同桃園市青年局个青年諮詢委員經驗。這滿在中壢後站个「客 客 客到人文化工作室」經營客語生活空間、同時身為「集樹子樂庄 PoPoChi Music」个團長。

en.name: LoLo Vong
en.bio: As a member of the Hakka community from the Liudui area and Taoyuan, I've always embraced my heritage without being stubborn. My passion lies in creating music, exploring languages, and delving into literature. I've gained experience in cultural exhibitions, Hakka language hosting, music composition, language teaching, and community work. I founded the "Hakka Global" community brand and currently serve as a youth advisory member for the first Youth Advisory Committee of the Hakka Affairs Council and as a civil society member for the third National Action Plan on Open Government under the Executive Yuan. Previously, I have also been a youth advisory member for both the Executive Yuan and the Taoyuan City Youth Affairs Bureau. I manage the "Hakka Global Cultural Studio" in Zhongli, which serves as a Hakka language and lifestyle space. Additionally, I lead the band "PoPoChi Music."

zh.name: 劉哲瑋
zh.bio: g0v 零時政府揪松團是 g0v 社群內籌辦雙月大黑客松、基礎松，以及推動募款事務的工作小組，也協助社群經營一處 30 位活動人數場地規模的台北社群空間 (g0v Taipei Community Hub)，目前有 8 位志工，以及專案合作人員。

en.name: Che-wei Liu
en.bio: The g0v Civic Engagement Team is responsible for organizing bi-monthly hackathons and foundational workshops within the g0v community. They also lead fundraising efforts and manage a Taipei community space, the g0v Taipei Community Hub, which can accommodate up to 30 participants. Currently, the team consists of 8 volunteers and project collaborators.

zh.name: 劉雁
zh.bio: 源自 COSCUP 行銷坑，之後陸續出沒於 SITCON、g0v Summit、CCTW，亦曾擔任拉贊與出納志工。碩班期間接觸資訊社會學，開始思考如何讓地方與人文領域更容易接觸開放精神，並在行動中實驗開放概念。曾於前瞻計畫推動開放資料與 CC，加入 OCF 後，嘗試以不同角度、更用力地推動開放。

en.name: Ian Liu
en.bio: Emerging from the marketing team at COSCUP, I've consistently participated in events like SITCON, g0v Summit, and CCTW, and have volunteered in fundraising and treasury roles. During my graduate studies, I was introduced to the sociology of information, which inspired me to explore how local communities and the humanities can better embrace the spirit of openness. I began experimenting with open concepts in practice. Through the Forward-looking Project, I advocated for open data and Creative Commons, and after joining OCF, I have been working even more vigorously to promote openness from various perspectives.

zh.name: 劉碧嬋
zh.bio: 劉碧嬋 Patsian 目前擔任 AVPN 副執行長兼市場長，憑藉橫跨亞洲與北美的永續金融、企業慈善及非營利組織領導經驗，領導 AVPN 全球市場策略與拓展。成立於 2011 年，AVPN 是亞洲最大的社會投資人網絡，協助超過 700 家會員機構連結、學習、行動、倡議，將資源有效的導入社會影響力。其中 AVPN「亞太人工智慧機會基金」在 Google.org 和亞洲開發銀行的支持下，幫助弱勢勞工和微中小企業提升 AI 知識和技能，在 AI 驅動的勞動力轉型中蓬勃發展。除了支持講師培訓，AVPN 也加強跨部門合作、參與政策對話，以促進亞太地區人工智慧技能生態系統的發展。

en.name: Patsian Low
en.bio:
Patsian Low, Chief of Markets and Deputy CEO at AVPN, leads membership growth and strategic partnerships. Leveraging her extensive expertise in sustainable finance, philanthropy, and non-profit leadership across the US and Asia, she drives the organization’s expansion and impact strategy.

As Asia’s largest social investment network, AVPN builds ecosystems to direct capital toward social impact. A key initiative is the "APAC AI Opportunity Fund," supported by Google.org and the Asian Development Bank. The fund empowers workers and MSMEs with essential AI skills to thrive in a digital economy. Beyond training, AVPN strengthens cross-sector collaboration and policy dialogue to foster a robust regional AI skills ecosystem.

zh.name: 劉維人
zh.bio:
獨立研究者。目前著重數位身分與個資治理，尤其分散式驗證（decentralized authentication）的信任框架、制度設計、市場真實需求。參與台灣「數位憑證皮夾」計畫擔任智庫，分析規範與架構、責任邊界、驗證流程、風險條件等核心需求。

亦為專業譯者，長期翻譯民主政治、政經制度與科技社會議題的非虛構作品。

en.name: Wei Jen Liu
en.bio: Independent researcher with a focus on digital identity and personal data governance, particularly in the areas of decentralized authentication trust frameworks, institutional design, and real market needs. Engaged in Taiwan's "Digital Credential Wallet" project as a think tank member, analyzing key requirements such as regulations and frameworks, boundaries of responsibility, authentication processes, and risk conditions.Also a professional translator, with extensive experience translating non-fiction works on topics related to democratic politics, political and economic systems, and technology in society.

zh.name: 蔡惠玉
zh.bio:
蔡惠玉，社群暱稱「英國阿美」。現任英國僑務委員、曼徹斯特台灣人協會會長，是一位具備豐富商業背景與跨國實務經驗的公共事務行動者。

她長年活躍於英國的公共參與現場，不僅定期參與彩虹遊行與聲援烏克蘭，更曾與西藏社群並肩抗議威權擴張。她擅長以多元形式實踐外交：從賽場上的台灣啦啦隊組織，到策辦《Big》、紀錄片座談及難民救助。透過跨文化經營，她成功將台灣主權議題轉化為具備國際共鳴的人道與民主觀點。

在 g0v Summit 2026 中，她將分享如何整合線上協作與實體資源，讓參與模式不再受限於現場，使身處不同地域的夥伴都能找到投身行動的入口。她也將探討如何透過跨議題串連，在地理邊界之外，建構出具備草根韌性的海外連線網絡，持續讓台灣價值在國際社會被深度看見。

en.name: Christina
en.bio:
Cai Huiyu, known in the community as "British Amei," is a current Overseas Affairs Commissioner for the UK and the President of the Taiwanese Association of Manchester. She is a public affairs activist with a rich background in business and international practical experience.

Cai has been actively engaged in public participation in the UK for many years. She regularly takes part in Pride parades and rallies in support of Ukraine, and she has stood alongside the Tibetan community in protest against authoritarian expansion. She excels in practicing diplomacy through diverse means, from organizing Taiwanese cheerleading squads at sports events to hosting discussions on documentaries like "Big" and aiding refugees. Through cross-cultural initiatives, she has successfully transformed Taiwan's sovereignty issues into humanitarian and democratic perspectives with international resonance.

At the g0v Summit 2026, Cai will share her insights on integrating online collaboration with physical resources, enabling participation beyond physical presence so that partners from different regions can find ways to engage in action. She will also discuss how to connect across issues to build resilient grassroots networks beyond geographical boundaries, ensuring that Taiwan's values continue to gain significant visibility in the international community.

zh.name: 鄧東波
zh.bio: 本報告主編，Civic Sense 計畫主持人，長期協助 OCF 推動開放資料相關政策倡議與資料治理實務建議。於 Civic Sense 專案致力於將環境監測資料整理並釋出為開放資料，並透過社群協作，鼓勵公民科技組織採用開源工具、理解開放資料的實際應用模式。亦曾擔任多個政府機關之開放資料顧問，參與公私協作與制度實務討論。

en.name: Dongpo Deng
en.bio: The lead author of this report and the director of the Civic Sense project has been actively supporting OCF in promoting open data policy advocacy and providing practical data governance recommendations. Within the Civic Sense project, they focus on organizing and releasing environmental monitoring data as open data. By fostering community collaboration, they encourage civic tech organizations to utilize open-source tools and understand practical applications of open data. They have also served as an open data consultant for various government agencies, participating in public-private collaborations and discussions on institutional practices.

zh.name: 黎恩灝
zh.bio: 黎恩灝 (Eric Lai)，倫敦大學亞非學院（SOAS）法律哲學博士、美國喬治城大學亞洲法中心（GCAL）高級研究員。他的研究範圍包括威權及混合政體下的憲法、法與社會、資訊自由及國際人權保障。近著有《在夾縫中抵抗：從依法治國與司法抗爭的比較經驗看香港》和 *Legal Resistance Under Authoritarianism: The Struggle for the Rule of Law in Hong Kong*。

en.name: Yan-ho Lai
en.bio: Dr. Yan-ho Lai, aka Eric Lai, is a Senior Fellow at Georgetown Center for Asian Law (GCAL), and the author of *Legal Resistance under Authoritarianism: The Struggle for the Rule of Law in Hong Kong*. His main research focuses on law and politics, law and society, law and social movement, national security, information freedom and international human rights laws and practices in hybrid and authoritarian regimes.

zh.name: 戴辰宇
zh.bio: 台灣駭客協會理事，Rakuten CERT 威脅情資團隊負責人。除負責事件響應與威脅狩獵外，亦致力於為藍隊（防禦方）建置內部系統，以因應新興的網路威脅。他曾多次在 CTF 競賽與漏洞獎金計畫中獲獎，並受邀於多場國際大會擔任講師，包括 HITCON、TROOPERS、CODE BLUE 及 IEEE GCCE 等。

en.name: GD
en.bio: The board member of Association of Hackers in Taiwan. The leading Threat Intelligence team at Rakuten CERT. Besides incident response and threat hunting roles, he builds in-house systems for Blue Team to deal with emerging cyber threats. He has received some prizes from CTFs, bug bounty programs, and been speaker at several conferences: HITCON, TROOPERS, CODE BLUE, IEEE GCCE, etc.

zh.name: 嚴婉玲
zh.bio: 台南人，地方事務參與者，開放政府協作者、民主政治信仰者。

en.name: Urda Yen
en.bio: Tainan residents, local affairs participants, open government collaborators, and believers in democratic politics.

zh.name: Aidan
zh.bio: Aidan 是在 eQualitie 負責 dComms 專案的軟體開發和專案負責人。dComms 是一套在烏克蘭網路審查、網路中斷和限制期間的替代通訊方式。eQualitie 長期以來關注網路隱私、駭客文化和網路安全。除此之外，他們也是多個技術社群的成員，與全球夥伴為個人和團體提供表達言論的技術工具及設施。

en.name: Aidan
en.bio: Aidan is currently Software Developer of dComms. He is a Decentralized System Administrator working on censorship circumvention at eQualitie. They have had a long-time interest in online privacy, hacker culture, and cybersecurity. They are members of several tech collectives that host infrastructure for individuals and groups to voice political dissent.

zh.bio: NFT Collector, FAB DAO藝術銀行小組二代聯絡人

en.bio: NFT Collector, Second-Generation Liaison for the FAB DAO Art Bank Group

en.name: chihao
en.bio: Building civic tech tools for countering information manipulation in East Asia.

zh.name: Claire
zh.bio:
Claire 是一名獨立工作者，關注公民科技與公共參與。她參與 g0v 國會松的主題規劃，透過設計活動流程，讓來自不同領域的講者與參與者能在現場充分交流；同時，她也發起了 g0v 國會松電子報，整理國內外與「國會資料使用」相關的科技應用。

他同時在 LawTrace 專案中擔任專案經理。在 LawTrace 的實作過程中，持續摸索如何讓公共資料變得更容易被理解與使用。

en.name: Claire
en.bio:
Claire is a freelancer focused on civic technology and public engagement. She participates in planning the themes for the g0v Congress hackathons, designing event processes to facilitate meaningful exchanges between speakers and participants from diverse fields. Additionally, she initiated the g0v Congress Newsletter, which compiles technological applications related to the use of parliamentary data both domestically and internationally.

She also serves as a project manager for the LawTrace project, where she continuously explores ways to make public data more accessible and easier to understand and use.

zh.name: Denken Chen
zh.bio: 實踐者，主要專案包含：立法院大小聲、FAB DAO 超證儀表板、Web3Matters 馬特週報等，參與台灣數位憑證皮夾專案與 W3C 國際標準事務，亦為 W3C CCG 共同主席，致力於亞太地區連結。Contributor, with major projects including Voices of Legislative Yuan, FAB DAO Hypercerts Dashboard, and Web3Matters Weekly. Actively involved in Taiwan’s Digital Identity Wallet project and W3C international standardization efforts, and serves as Co-Chair of the W3C Credentials Community Group (CCG), dedicated to strengthening connections across the Asia-Pacific region.

en.name: Denken Chen
en.bio: Practitioner, with key projects such as Voices of the Legislative Yuan, FAB DAO Hypercerts Dashboard, and Web3Matters Weekly. Actively engaged in Taiwan's Digital Identity Wallet initiative and W3C international standardization activities. Co-Chair of the W3C Credentials Community Group (CCG), committed to enhancing civic engagement and strengthening connections throughout the Asia-Pacific region.

en.bio: FAB DAO Action Lounge Group Third Term Liaison

zh.name: Ian.Wu
zh.bio: 工程師，學生時期曾活躍於多項社會運動。致力於結合技術專業與人文精神，推動數位治理發展。現任司改會數位法治小組成員。

en.name: Ian.Wu
en.bio: As a student, the engineer was actively involved in various social movements, demonstrating a strong commitment to civic engagement. They are dedicated to integrating technical expertise with humanistic values to advance digital governance. Currently, they serve as a member of the Digital Law and Governance Committee at the Judicial Reform Foundation.

zh.name: Irvin Chen
zh.bio:
Irvin Chen (開放文化基金會[網路韌性專案](https://resilience.ocf.tw)研究員 / G0v 韌性松 / Mozilla 貢獻者，[摩茲工寮社群空間](https://moztw.space) Keyholder。近期，Irvin 的興趣在理解[數位政策與法規，對於網路平台、言論自由及民主發展的影響](https://moztw.org/events/service-regulator/)，以及試圖深掘「[海纜斷光，到底會怎麼樣？](https://resilience.ocf.tw/web/)」的答案。

他同時是前端工程師與開源社群參與者。十多年來擔任 Mozilla 台灣社群聯絡人，負責跨國志工與專案協調，並共同管理摩茲工寮社群空間。他曾在女人迷 womany.net 負責網站前端架構規劃，並協助設計 DEI 企業評鑑等策略產品，推動臺灣職場平權與多元包容。長期參與 g0v 社群，曾協助將國台語及多個族語納入 [Common Voice 開源語音庫](https://commonvoice.mozilla.org/)，建制與釋出第一套完全免費且自由的[台灣多族語音資料集](https://moztw.org/common-voice)。今年起 Irvin 亦協助舉辦每月定期「g0v 韌性松」，關注國際海纜斷線對社會民生可能帶來的挑戰。目前，Irvin 擔任開放文化基金會技術顧問與海纜專案研究員。

en.name: Irvin Chen
en.bio: Irvin Chen is a dedicated researcher at the Open Culture Foundation's Internet Resilience Project and a key contributor to g0v's Resilience Hackathon and Mozilla. As a keyholder at the MozTW Community Space, his recent focus has been on understanding the impact of digital policies and regulations on internet platforms, freedom of speech, and democratic development. He is also exploring the critical question: "What would happen if submarine cables were disrupted?"In addition to his research, Irvin is a front-end engineer and an active participant in open-source communities. For over a decade, he has served as the liaison for the Mozilla Taiwan Community, coordinating international volunteers and projects, and co-managing the MozTW Community Space. He has also worked with Womany.net on front-end architecture planning and helped design DEI corporate evaluations and other strategic products to promote workplace equality and diversity in Taiwan. Irvin has been a long-time participant in the g0v community, where he has contributed to the inclusion of Mandarin, Taiwanese, and various indigenous languages in the Common Voice open-source voice database. This effort led to the creation and release of the first completely free and open Taiwanese multilingual voice dataset. Since this year, Irvin has been helping to organize the monthly "g0v Resilience Hackathon," focusing on the societal challenges posed by potential international submarine cable disruptions. Currently, Irvin serves as a technical advisor and submarine cable project researcher at the Open Culture Foundation.

zh.name: James Kan
zh.bio: 在公民科技與開放國會領域工作，致力於將複雜的立法與預算流程轉化為一般大眾也能理解與使用的公共工具。工作連結了公民社會、公共機構與科技社群，並在國會監督、開放資料平台與參與式專案方面擁有豐富的實務經驗。持續與在地及區域性網絡合作，探索公民科技如何強化透明度、問責性與民主韌性。

en.name: James Kan
en.bio: Working in the field of civic technology and open parliament, I am dedicated to transforming complex legislative and budgetary processes into public tools that are accessible and understandable to the general public. My work connects civil society, public institutions, and the tech community, with extensive practical experience in parliamentary oversight, open data platforms, and participatory projects. I continuously collaborate with local and regional networks to explore how civic technology can enhance transparency, accountability, and the resilience of democracy.

zh.name: Jieping
zh.bio: Annie Zhang Jieping is a media entrepreneur, award-winning journalist, and thought leader at the intersection of technology, freedom of expression, and civic engagement in the Chinese-speaking world. A 2024 Nieman–Berkman Fellow at Harvard University, she explores the future of digital public space and civic trust in increasingly authoritarian contexts. Zhang is the founder and CEO of Matters Lab, an independent media platform that fosters decentralised publishing and dialogue among Chinese-speaking communities through innovative use of Web3 technologies. She also founded Nowhere Bookstore, a space for diaspora Chinese community. With over a decade of experience in journalism, Zhang previously served as editorial in chief at Initium Media and held positions at Asia Weekly and City Magazine. Her work has consistently focused on press freedom, digital rights, and reimagining the future of journalism in politically restricted environments. Named a Yale Poynter Fellow in Journalism, Zhang’s work bridges media innovation and social impact, challenging censorship while empowering grassroots storytelling.

en.name: Jieping
en.bio: Annie Zhang Jieping is a media entrepreneur, award-winning journalist, and thought leader at the intersection of technology, freedom of expression, and civic engagement in the Chinese-speaking world. zh.name: Jo
zh.bio: 台南社區大學環境行動小組助理研究員。在英國攻讀自然資源管理時，以為自己理解台灣；回到田野後才發現，進去才能理解土地，不出來卻看不清全貌。於是在進進出出之間捕捉與比較，用距離看見結構性問題，用貼近找到行動方法。目前嘗試將台南社大二十多年累積的田野經驗，轉譯為可被他人學習與複製的行動方法。

en.name: Jo
en.bio: Assistant Researcher for the Environmental Action Group at Tainan Community University. While studying natural resource management in the UK, I thought I understood Taiwan. However, it was only when I returned to work in the field that I realized you need to immerse yourself to truly grasp the land, yet stepping back is necessary to see the bigger picture. In navigating between these perspectives, I aim to identify and compare issues, using distance to recognize structural problems and proximity to discover actionable methods. Currently, I'm working on translating over two decades of field experience at Tainan Community University into actionable methods that others can learn from and replicate.

zh.bio: Code for Korea 貢獻者

en.name: KLOU
en.bio: Code for Korea contributor

zh.name: 仔魚
zh.bio: 投入圍繞矽谷周邊，快三歲大的 g0v 灣區社群

en.name: Lisa Ky
en.bio: The nearly three-year-old g0v Bay Area community is actively engaging in civic initiatives around Silicon Valley.

zh.name: Lulu Keng
zh.bio:
CRC賽伯格韌性實驗室成員，科技與社會研究所碩一，開放文化基金會董事。

工作跨了幾次領域後，開始難以說明自己到底是做甚麼，過去十年則是以數位人權、網路自由、資安隱私、跨國交流為主要活動領域，自認為的專長是協助科技人＆非科技人聽懂對方說什麼，以及寫專案計劃和結案。現在又重回學校嘗試擠出屬於自己的計劃。

在踏入數位科技領域之前，則輾轉於環境調查／社會運動／獨立音樂／行銷公關相關領域，尋找可以貢獻己力又合胃口的小角落，觀察並執行跨領域的各類專案。

en.name: Lulu Keng
en.bio: Lulu Keng has spent the past ten years working at the intersection of digital rights, open government, and civil society digital empowerment, both in Taiwan and internationally. She is currently a member of Cyborg Resilience Co-Lab(CRC) and Board member of Open Culture Foundation.

zh.name: Maxime Cuillerier
zh.bio: Maxime Cuillerier 目前於蒙特婁的加拿大國立政府行政學院（ENAP）攻讀公共行政博士班。此前，他於拉瓦爾大學取得工商管理碩士（MBA）學位，專攻機器學習與商業分析。Maxime 在加拿大政府服務超過 18 年，期間曾擔任多項營運與策略職位。在他的職業生涯中，他致力於推動多項與人工智慧及組織變革相關的專案。在學術研究方面，Maxime 關注的領域包括：公民駭客、數位創業／內部創業、數位公共服務的共同創作、人機關係，以及後人文主義本體論在公共組織中的應用。

en.name: Maxime Cuillerier
en.bio: Maxime Cuillerier is currently a PhD student in public administration at École nationale d’administration publique (ENAP) in Montréal. Previously, he earned an MBA specialized in machine learning and business analytics from Université Laval. Maxime has been working for over 18 years at the Government of Canada, where he has held various operational and strategic positions. During his professional career, he has had the opportunity to work on various projects related to artificial intelligence and organizational change. In terms of scientific research, Maxime is interested in civic hacking, digital intrapreneurship/entrepreneurship, co-creation of digital public services, human-AI relation, application of Posthumanist ontologies in public organizations.

zh.name: MG Lee
zh.bio:
CRC賽伯格韌性實驗室共同創辦人。

游走在數位、資料、賽伯格間的後/人類學家。g0v零時政府的參與者與民族誌工作者。著有《「沒有人」的運動》一書。現任中央研究院民族學研究所助研究員。

en.name: MG Lee
en.bio:
Co-founder of the Cyborg Resilience Co-Lab (CRC).

MG is a post/anthropologist navigating the realms of digital technology, data, and cyborgs. She is an active participant and ethnographer of the g0v (gov-zero) community, and the author of the book The Movement of "Nobody". Currently, MG serves as an Assistant Research Fellow at the Institute of Ethnology, Academia Sinica.

zh.name: Michael Suantak
zh.bio:
Founder & Lead Technologist, eimiAI | Director, ASORCOM

Michael Suantak 是一位數位安全專家、社會創新者與公民科技工作者，長期致力於連結數位人權與生存工程（survival engineering）。他現在為 Alternative Solutions for Rural Communities（ASORCOM）主任及 SAVORY 社會企業執行長，並發起「社群無線合作網絡」（CWC），透過網狀網路與太陽能技術，為緬印邊境偏遠與衝突地區提供離網的通訊連結。

目前他也是 eimiAI 的創辦人與首席技術長，專注於將邊緣人工智慧帶入資源匱乏的社群，推動倫理資料應用與離線大型語言模型（LLM），以支持與保存低資源原住民族語言。此外，他亦長期投入數位安全倡議，並與 Internews 與 MDIF 等國際組織合作，為亞洲高風險環境中的記者、獨立媒體與人權工作者提供資安訓練與營運安全（OPSEC）支援。

en.name: Michael Suantak
en.bio:
Founder & Lead Technologist, eimiAI | Director, ASORCOM.

Michael Suantak is a digital security expert, social innovator, and civic technologist with over two decades of experience operating at the intersection of digital rights and survival engineering. He is the Director of Alternative Solutions for Rural Communities (ASORCOM) and the CEO of the SAVORY Social Enterprise. Through ASORCOM, Michael pioneered the Community Wireless Cooperative (CWC), an initiative that provides autonomous, off-grid internet and intranet connectivity to remote and conflict-affected regions along the Myanmar-India border using grassroots mesh networks and solar infrastructure.

Currently, Michael serves as the Founder and Lead Technologist at eimiAI, where he focuses on bringing Edge AI to isolated communities. His work centers on ethical data sourcing and developing offline Large Language Models (LLMs) to preserve and serve low-resource indigenous languages.

Alongside his infrastructure work, Michael is a dedicated advocate for digital safety. He consults for international organizations such as Internews and the Media Development Investment Fund (MDIF), providing critical cybersecurity training, risk mitigation, and operational security (OPSEC) support for journalists, independent media houses, and human rights defenders operating in high-risk environments across Asia.

zh.name: Nao
zh.bio: Nao Myoshu 目前擔任 Code for Japan 的社群協調人。他專精於國際協作，並曾於日本國內外多次主導工作坊與活動；透過深耕社群參與，促進各方合作並創造實質影響力。

en.name: Nao
en.bio: Nao Myoshu is a Community Coordinator at Code for Japan. Nao specializes in international collaboration and has led workshops and events in Japan and abroad, fostering cooperation and creating meaningful impact through community engagement.

zh.name: Powen Shiah
zh.bio: Powen 現任職於 Sovereign Tech Agency，負責通訊傳播事務。他曾於德國及美國的科技新創公司深耕產品行銷、企業傳播與國際化經營等領域，並熱衷於探究科技對人類生活的影響。他近期的頭號興趣是蒐集各種口味（鹹食系）的爆米花調味粉。

en.name: Powen Shiah
en.bio: Powen handles communications at the Sovereign Tech Agency. He’s worked in product marketing, communications, and internationalization in technology startups in Germany and the US, and really enjoys thinking about how technologies impact our lives. His latest passion is a growing collection of (savory) popcorn seasonings.

zh.name: RSChiang
zh.bio:
姜柏任（RSChiang）是 g0v Summit 2026 的總召集人，專注於資訊法、數位政府與開放資料的研究與倡議。自 2012 年起投身開源社群並共同發起 [SITCON](https://sitcon.org/)，致力於台灣資訊教育的變革與協作精神的紮根。

新竹客家人，藉由貢獻 g0v 專案找回與長輩的語言連結與肩頸酸痛的硬頸精神。平常出沒於黑客松現場與 [Mastodon](https://g0v.social/@RSChiang)，不寫程式的時候都把時間省下來——不是在想諧音梗，就是在尋找艾草粄與肉桂捲的路上。

en.name: RSChiang
en.bio:
Poren Chiang (RSChiang) is the Chief Coordinator of g0v Summit 2026. He is digital law researcher specialized in digital governance and open data. Since joining the open-source community in 2012, he co-founded [SITCON](https://sitcon.org/) to drive transformation in Taiwan’s IT education and cultivate a culture of collaboration.

Born with a Hakka ancestry from Hsinchu, Poren reconnected with his ancestral tongue through his contributions to g0v projects. You may spot him at hackathons and on [Mastodon](https://g0v.social/@RSChiang). He usually saves his time either crafting puns or going on a quest for the perfect ngiě-bán or cinnamon roll.

zh.name: Sandra
zh.bio: Sandra 是一名獨立工作者，擔任 LawTrace 專案的 UI/UX 設計師。她長期參與公民科技與公私協力相關專案，期待讓數位服務與公共對話真正貼近使用者的日常體驗。工作之外，她也是一名斜槓調酒師，跟無數植物的奴隸。

en.name: Sandra
en.bio: Sandra is a freelancer working as a UI/UX designer on the LawTrace project. She has been actively involved in civic tech and public-private partnership projects, aiming to make digital services and public discourse more relevant to users' everyday experiences. Outside of work, she is also a multifaceted bartender and a devoted caretaker of countless plants.

zh.name: Sandy Hsueh
zh.bio:
現任歐洲台灣協會會長，曾任法國台灣協會會長。自上個世紀起旅居英國、法國及德國，現居法國。

近年致力於在非英語系的歐洲政治與社會脈絡中，透過文化行動、公共溝通與數位外交，串連海外台灣社群並提升台灣的國際能見度。

她不僅是海外台灣人權益的倡議者，更是跨國民主網絡的推動者。憑藉深耕歐洲多年的實務經驗，她擅長將台灣的主權與民主議題轉化為當地社會能理解的公共討論。

在 g0v Summit 2026 中，她將結合其在歐洲第一線的觀察，展示如何打破地理疆界，讓全球台灣人社群共同參與社會韌性的建構。

en.name: Sandy Hsueh
en.bio:
The current President of the European Taiwan Association and former President of the French Taiwan Association has resided in the UK, France, and Germany since the last century and currently lives in France.

In recent years, she has focused on connecting the overseas Taiwanese community and enhancing Taiwan's international visibility within the political and social contexts of non-English-speaking Europe through cultural initiatives, public communication, and digital diplomacy.

She is not only an advocate for the rights of overseas Taiwanese but also a promoter of transnational democratic networks. With years of practical experience deeply rooted in Europe, she excels at translating Taiwan's sovereignty and democracy issues into public discussions that are understandable in the local context.

At the g0v Summit 2026, she will share her frontline observations from Europe, demonstrating how to transcend geographical boundaries and enable the global Taiwanese community to participate in building social resilience.

zh.name: Swift Evo
zh.bio: 專注 DeSci 以及 Public Goods，GreenSofa 主理人，DeSci Asia co-founder等，亞洲地區推動去中心科研 DeSci 以及 公共財 Public Goods funding 的發展。

en.name: Swift Evo
en.bio: Focus on DeSci & Public Goods. GreenSofa steward & DeSci Asia co-founder. Aim to contribute Decentralized Science & Public Goods funding development in Asia.

zh.name: Tmonk
zh.bio: Tmonk 是歐噴（OpenFun）的工程師，在 LawTrace 專案中負責資料清理與網站架設，讓立法院開放資料能被穩定整理與呈現。寫程式之外，他也常協助 g0v 國會松做直播，把現場的討論與演講傳送到線上，讓不在場的人也能一起參與公共對話。

en.name: Tmonk
en.bio: Tmonk is an engineer at OpenFun, where he works on the LawTrace project, focusing on data cleaning and website development to ensure that the open data from the Legislative Yuan is organized and presented in a stable manner. Beyond programming, he frequently assists with g0v's Congressional Hackathons by livestreaming the events, allowing those who are not physically present to engage in public discussions and speeches online.

en.name: Yii

zh.name: 司改會數位法小組
zh.bio: 司改會數位法小組由法律、技術及人權跨領域專家組成，針對公、私領域數位化中的人權議題展開行動。我們即時回應個案與修法脈動，同時致力於建構整體而長期的法治改善—推出「數位權利基本法」草案，期望能監督權力不被濫用，並賦予人民數位權利的主張基礎，使台灣邁向更自由開放的數位社會。本工作坊將由數位法小組團隊帶領。

en.name: JRF Digital Law Taskforce
en.bio: The Digital Law Group of the Judicial Reform Foundation is composed of interdisciplinary experts in law, technology, and human rights, focusing on human rights issues in the digitization of both public and private sectors. We respond promptly to individual cases and legislative changes, while also working towards comprehensive and long-term improvements in the rule of law. Our draft proposal for a "Basic Law on Digital Rights" aims to prevent the abuse of power and provide a foundation for citizens to assert their digital rights, guiding Taiwan towards a more free and open digital society. This workshop will be led by the Digital Law Group team.

zh.name: 國立臺灣大學客家研究社
zh.bio: 國立臺灣大學客家研究社（NTU Hakka）創立於 1991 年，正值解嚴後「還我母語運動」的浪潮之中。成立 35 年來，臺大客家社以推廣客語、客家文化作為核心信念，重視語言文化傳播、傳承。初期主要開設客語教學班、舉辦演講比賽，後逐漸轉型，透過介紹不同國家的客家社群、醫護客語、客語桌遊等多元活動形式吸引年輕人加入、促進族群交流，在日常生活「做客家」。

en.name: NTU Hakka
en.bio:
Founded in 1991 during the post-martial law “Restore My Mother Tongue” movement, the National Taiwan University Hakka Club has spent 35 years dedicated to its core mission: the promotion and preservation of Hakka language and culture.

While its early years focused on language classes and speech competitions, the club has since evolved. Today, it engages younger generations through diverse activities—such as exploring global Hakka communities, teaching Hakka medical terms, and hosting board game nights—to foster ethnic exchange and integrate Hakka identity into everyday life.

zh.name: Coseeing 嶼我共視
zh.bio: 打造一個包容的數位環境，不只是為了現在的身障者，更是在為未來的自己，鋪好一條能被好好使用的路。全世界約有四分之一的人口是身心障礙者或年長者，因感官退化、身體限制或認知差異，在使用數位產品時面臨重重困難。而我們每一個人，也都正在通往「變老」的路上。無障礙從來不是少數人的需求，而是每個人都會面對的日常。A11y Camp 是一場以體驗為起點、以包容為核心的數位無障礙工作坊。我們邀請參與者暫時放下對視覺的依賴，改用「聽」來操作手機與數位服務。當畫面不再可見，只能透過聲音尋找內容、理解狀態、進行操作時，許多原本被忽略的問題，會變得格外清晰。在活動中，參與者將實際開啟手機的螢幕閱讀器，體驗視障者如何在聲音中導航，理解為何不清楚的指引、混亂的資訊結構，會讓人迷失方向。邀請你來參加，透過親身體驗，感受不同的數位世界！

en.name: Coseeing
en.bio:
Creating an inclusive digital environment is not just about accommodating people with disabilities today; it's about paving the way for our own future. Approximately one-quarter of the global population consists of individuals with disabilities or older adults who face significant challenges with digital products due to sensory decline, physical limitations, or cognitive differences. All of us are on the path to aging, and accessibility is not a niche requirement but an everyday necessity for everyone.

A11y Camp is a digital accessibility workshop focused on inclusivity, starting with experiential learning. We invite participants to temporarily set aside their reliance on visual cues and instead use auditory methods to navigate smartphones and digital services. When visuals are no longer accessible and content must be found, understood, and operated through sound, many overlooked issues become glaringly apparent. During the event, participants will activate their phone's screen reader to experience how visually impaired individuals navigate through audio cues, gaining insight into how unclear instructions and disorganized information can lead to confusion.

Join us to explore a different digital world through firsthand experience and gain a deeper understanding of the importance of digital accessibility!
